promise.text: Home maintenance checklist by month (short version)

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "home"

lines.text: January to December in one short list: only the jobs that belong to a month and cause damage if skipped.

head.text: Look for tree limbs over the roof or near power lines.

body.text: Book any pruning now, before spring growth.

head.text: Walk the outside once the snow is gone.

body.text: Check that downspouts drain away from the house and that the soil hasn't sunk toward the foundation.

head.text: Look at the roof from the ground for lifted or missing shingles.

body.text: Switch ceiling fans to summer direction and dust the blades.

head.text: Have the AC serviced if you haven't.

body.text: Reconnect hoses and turn outdoor water back on, then look for drips at the faucet.
Touch up exterior paint or caulk while the weather is dry.

line.text: It holds the timing for you and raises a job when it is worth doing, then goes quiet again. Nothing sits on screen permanently.
